defects.title: Off-UTC-grid contiguous OHLCV incorrectly accepted as verified candle history
defects.reproduction: Supply 48 contiguous H1 candles with openTime = UTC-hour + 15min; old closedWilliamsWaveBars accepted them and could form wave evidence from non-native exchange hour boundaries.
defects.root_cause: Freshness + bar continuity checks did not require Binance native UTC timeframe-open alignment.
defects.fix: Reject off-grid candle opens for fixed Binance intervals; treat 1w as Monday-aligned. Do not disable or soften old STOP.
defects.residual_risk: Native exchange-source time and signed data not fully end-to-end verified.

defects.title: Historical 15-asset exams used UNIUSDT instead of authorized SUIUSDT
defects.reproduction: Prior 2026-11-23 backend run 45169894054 logs listed UNIUSDT and no SUIUSDT in 90 H1 snapshots and 499 simulated trades.
defects.root_cause: Historical frozen-corpus list hardcoded a legacy 15-symbol set inconsistent with trading_config.DEFAULT_FUTURES_SYMBOLS.
defects.fix: Load and validate 480 2024-11-09 through 2024-11-29 closed public Binance SUIUSDT H1 bars; use SUI instead of UNI in both benchmarks; enforce exact equality with approved trading universe.
defects.residual_risk: 2024 tick filters not certified; 2026 SUI tick used for illustrative paper replay; closed-period dataset is not independent holdout.

defects.title: Corrupted contiguous native M15/H1/H4/weekly/monthly candles could pass market-data and SQLite cache boundaries
defects.reproduction: Native market-data cache validated consecutive candle timestamps but accepted a 5-minute-shifted M15 or 15-minute-shifted H1 series, and monthly candles not at first-day UTC 00:00.
defects.root_cause: Market-data/native SQLite integrity and last-closed freshness checked relative adjacency, not absolute UTC-native kline opening grid.
defects.fix: Shared fixed-grid alignment helper (Monday weekly origin) plus UTC calendar-month validation applied at all cache/closed-bar gates; negative regression both sides and frames.
defects.residual_risk: Do not assume all exchange-native kline timestamps validated in every external cache and Python runtime; Android tests and signed integration remain mandatory.

Adaptive 3/4/5 vs fixed 3/4/5 and fractal out-of-sample common-cohort comparator not completed; 0.60/1.25/1.1 thresholds unvalidated engineering.
No user-device Samsung Android 17 foreground/Doze/boot continuity acceptance, no stable signing identity for an installable update.

acceptance_policy: Keep draft; do not promote to main or enable new high-risk orders on this audit evidence alone. No unverified defect is claimed fixed.
